cat > tests/core.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { describe,it,expect,vi } from 'vitest';
import { HypeDetector } from '../src/hype/detector.js';
import { detectLanguage } from '../src/translate/detect.js';
import { Translator } from '../src/translate/router.js';
import { PidginPhraseProvider } from '../src/translate/providers/pidgin.js';
import { tallyVotes, VoteGame } from '../src/game/vote.js';
import { HypeClipper } from '../src/hype/clipper.js';
import { ChatMessage, HelixClient } from '../src/twitch/types.js';
const msg=(text:string,ts:number,user='x',emotes:string[]=[]):ChatMessage=>({id:String(ts)+user,user,text,emotes,ts});
describe('hype detector',()=>{it('does not spike on steady chat',()=>{const d=new HypeDetector({floor:8});let spike=false;for(let i=0;i<20;i++)spike ||= d.ingest(msg('hello',i*1000)).spike;expect(spike).toBe(false)});it('spikes on bursts and weights keywords/emotes',()=>{const d=new HypeDetector({floor:8});let r;for(let i=0;i<5;i++)r=d.ingest(msg('W POG',60000+i*100,'x',['pog']));expect(r"'!.score).toBeGreaterThan(8);expect(r!.spike).toBe(true)});it('"'respects cooldown',()=>{const d=new HypeDetector({floor:8,cooldownMs:30000});expect(d.ingest(msg('W POG W POG',1)).spike).toBe(true);expect(d.ingest(msg('W POG W POG',5000)).spike).toBe(false)})});
describe('language and translation',()=>{it('detects pidgin yoruba french and english',()=>{expect(detectLanguage('wetin dey happen').lang).toBe('pcm');expect(detectLanguage('Ẹ káàrọ̀').lang).toBe('yo');expect(detectLanguage('Bonjour merci').lang).toBe('fr');expect(detectLanguage('Thanks for the game').lang).toBe('en')});it('translates known pidgin and passes english; handles unavailable provider',async()=>{expect(new PidginPhraseProvider().translate('how far','en')?.translated).toBe('how are you');const t=new Translator([]);expect((await t.translate('Thanks for the game')).provider).toBe('passthrough');expect((await t.translate('Bonjour')).provider).toBe('unavailable')})});
describe('votes',()=>{it('uses latest vote per user and ignores invalid options',()=>{const v=new VoteGame(async()=>{});v.current={prompt:'?',options:['a','b','c'],endsAt:1,votes:new Map()};v.handle(msg('"'!vote a'"',1,'n'));v.handle(msg('"'!vote b'"',2,'n'));v.handle(msg('"'!vote z'"',3,'x'));expect(tallyVotes(v.current.votes).counts).toEqual({a:0,b:1,c:0})});it('reports ties',()=>{expect(tallyVotes({x:'a',y:'b'})).toMatchObject({winner:null,tied:true})})});
describe('clipper',()=>{it('records marker and clip on spike',async()=>{const h:HelixClient={createMarker:vi.fn(async()=>({id:'m1'})),createClip:vi.fn(async()=>({id:'c1',editUrl:'edit'})),getClip:vi.fn(async id=>({id,url:'clip'})),sendChatMessage:vi.fn(async()=>{})};const c=new HypeClipper(h);const result=await c.onSpike({score:12,baseline:2,spike:true,messages:[msg('W',100)]},100);expect(h.createMarker).toHaveBeenCalled();expect(h.createClip).toHaveBeenCalled();expect(result).toMatchObject({markerId:'m1',clipId:'c1',clipUrl:'clip',status:'ready'})})});
EOF
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Stream Companion

A mock-first Twitch stream companion for Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon: a TypeScript chat bot that detects hype, saves clip moments, translates multilingual chat, runs quiet-chat votes, and drives a transparent OBS browser overlay. Mock mode runs end-to-end without Twitch credentials or paid APIs.

## Quick start

"'```sh
npm install
npm run demo -- --speed=2
```

Open [http://localhost:3000/overlay?bg=1](http://localhost:3000/overlay?bg=1) for the live demo with a preview background. `npm run demo` starts the server and scripted feeder; it exits when the feed ends. For a static screenshot, use `/overlay?demo=1&bg=1`.

## Features and architecture

```text
Twitch EventSub / mock feeder
          │ normalized ChatMessage
          ▼
   hype detector ──► clipper ──► Helix marker + clip
          │
          ├──► translator chain ──► translations
          └──► quiet detector ──► vote game ──► chat reply
                         │
                         ▼
            Express state + SSE events
                         │
                         ▼
                OBS browser overlay
```

The overlay shows a live hype meter, ranked moments, translations with confidence, and an in-progress vote. `POST /mock/chat` accepts `{ "user": "name", "text": "message", "emotes": [] }` in mock mode. `/state` returns the latest snapshot; `/events` streams updates.

## OBS browser source

Add a Browser Source pointing to `http://localhost:3000/overlay`, set width `1920`, height `1080`, and enable shutdown/hide behavior as preferred. The page uses a transparent background. Add `?bg=1` to preview with a checker pattern. Keep the local app running while OBS uses the source.

## Environment

Copy `.env.example` to `.env`; mock mode is the default.

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MODE | `mock` or `live` | `mock` |
| PORT | HTTP port | `3000` |
| TWITCH_CLIENT_ID | Twitch developer app client ID | empty |
| TWITCH_USER_TOKEN | User OAuth token | empty |
| TWITCH_BROADCASTER_ID | Streamer'"'s Twitch user ID | empty |
| TWITCH_BOT_USER_ID | Sending bot user ID | empty |
| LIBRETRANSLATE_URL | Self-hosted LibreTranslate base URL | disabled |
| LIBRETRANSLATE_API_KEY | Optional LibreTranslate key | empty |
| OPENAI_ENABLED / OPENAI_API_KEY | Optional translation provider; off by default | "'`false` / empty |
| NLLB_URL | Optional NLLB translation endpoint | disabled |
| HYPE_MULTIPLIER / HYPE_FLOOR / HYPE_COOLDOWN_MS / HYPE_TOP_N | Hype and moment tuning | see `.env.example` |
| QUIET_RATE / QUIET_SECONDS / VOTE_DURATION_SECONDS / GAME_COOLDOWN_SECONDS | Vote-game tuning | see `.env.example` |

Self-host LibreTranslate (no paid API): `docker run -p 5000:5000 libretranslate/libretranslate`, then set `LIBRETRANSLATE_URL=http://localhost:5000`. Yoruba NLLB integration is an optional HTTP adapter expecting `POST {"text","source_lang","target_lang"}` and response `{"translation":"..."}`; host a compatible NLLB inference service and set `NLLB_URL`. Built-in Pidgin phrase translation and a small Yoruba glossary work offline.

## Live Twitch setup

Create a Twitch developer application and obtain a user token for the broadcaster. Set `MODE=live`, client ID, token, broadcaster ID, and bot user ID. Grant `user:read:chat`, `user:write:chat`, `channel:manage:broadcast`, and `clips:edit` scopes. EventSub subscribes to `channel.chat.message`; Helix creates markers/clips and sends chat messages. Twitch live connectivity requires valid credentials and an active stream; this path is compile-ready and mock mode is the supported demo path.

## Development

```sh
npm run dev       # mock server
npm run feed      # feed into a running mock server
npm test
npm run typecheck
npm run build
```

`!vote a|b|c` casts a vote. The broadcaster can use `!reply <lang> <text>` (default broadcaster name `streamer`; configure `TWITCH_BROADCASTER_NAME` to override) to translate English into a target language and send it to chat.

## Built with OpenAI Codex

Stream Companion was built with OpenAI Codex for the Codex x TwitchCon Hackathon.
